title: Halting Drop Configurations
statement: For a Boolean mode and Boolean history $h$, define the halting configurations to be the reachable configurations for the drop machine using the drop oracle that satisfy the good-configuration condition for that mode and history and are halting configurations.
caveat: The halting and reachability predicates, oracle-machine semantics, and good-configuration predicate are not defined in the supplied statement.
